tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background on every screen. Warm and quiet so photographs carry the colour.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, bars and inputs sitting on paper.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Empty photo slots, progress tracks, neutral status chips and wells; on paper or surface.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed ground for rows, outlined buttons and rail items sitting on surface or paper. ink and ink-muted read on it.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and card outlines. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of buttons, inputs and pick chips; 3:1 on paper and surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on paper, surface and surface-sunken; fill of a selected pick chip, with paper as its text.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, instructions and metadata on paper, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: bottle
tokens.usage: The brand green. Primary action fill, active navigation, and the positive status (approved, covered, confirmed); as text on paper, surface and bottle-soft.

tokens.name: bottle-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of the primary button; on-bottle reads on it.

tokens.name: bottle-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind bottle text: positive status chips and the active tab.

tokens.name: on-bottle
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a bottle fill, such as the primary button label. Never literal white.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: The accent. Marks and fills for attention states (check due, needs label) and identity blocks; 3:1 on paper and surface, so it always sits beside a word. Text on a brass fill is ink in light and paper in dark.

tokens.name: brass-ink
tokens.usage: Attention text and icons on brass-soft, paper and surface.

tokens.name: brass-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind brass-ink: attention status chips and notices.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: In-progress status (uploading, processing, awaiting review) as text, icons and progress fill, on paper, surface, surface-sunken and sky-soft. Also links.

tokens.name: sky-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind sky text: in-progress status chips.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Problem status only (failed, needs replacing) and destructive actions. A solid chip fill, or text on paper, surface and signal-soft. Never decorative.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a signal fill.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind signal text: inline error messages.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px, on every interactive element. 3:1 on paper and surface.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay on photographs behind a count or caption, and behind sheets.

tokens.name: on-photo
tokens.usage: Text and icons on scrim over a photograph, in both themes.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Fraunces, hosted by Google Fonts. Names of things and big numbers only.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Screen title: the subject, the pub or the queue you are in. One per screen.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Coverage counts and other headline numbers. Set with tabular lining numerals.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Figtree, hosted by Google Fonts. Everything people read and tap.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card titles, list row titles and the venue name in the venue bar.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Show the whole plate from above, on the pass.
styles.usage: Instructions, notes and paragraphs. Never below 16px on staff screens.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, pick chips, tabs and form labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Status chips (at weight 600), metadata and helper text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between chips and between album tiles.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a card; between a thumbnail and its text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and phone screen gutters.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between sections; horizontal padding of a button.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop gutters and space above a screen title.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between major regions on manager and admin desktop layouts.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Thumbnails in rows and small inset elements.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, album tiles and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status chips, pick chips and the round Upload button.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Sheets, menus and the bottom tab bar only. Cards use line, not shadow.

tokens.name: target-staff
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of every primary action on staff screens.

tokens.name: target-compact
tokens.usage: Controls in manager and admin desktop tables and toolbars, and pick chips.

tokens.name: thumb-row
tokens.usage: Square thumbnail in job cards and upload rows.

tokens.name: tile-min
tokens.usage: Minimum album tile width; the grid fills with as many columns as fit.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: From this width: two-column layouts, album grid of four or more, sheets become centred dialogs.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: From this width: the side rail replaces the bottom tab bar for managers and admins; tables show all columns.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the main content column on desktop.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Width of the manager and admin side rail.

tokens.name: sheet-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a bottom sheet or dialog.
